# Connect UnifAPI to Grok

> Web connector — no terminal · read-only public-data MCP over OAuth — **eyes, not hands**.

Connect Grok to the UnifAPI public-data MCP server and run marketing research — SEO, AI-visibility (GEO), social, local, and competitive intelligence — from live public data without leaving Grok. A web connector — a couple of clicks, no terminal. One OAuth sign-in, no API key to paste; everything is read-only.

## Steps

### 1. Open the connector settings

In Grok, open the Connectors page:

[Open Grok Connectors](https://grok.com/connectors)

### 2. Add UnifAPI

Click "New connector", then "Custom".

Name it "UnifAPI" and paste the MCP server URL:

```text
https://mcp.unifapi.com
```

Click "Add Connector", then approve access in the UnifAPI tab.

### 3. Try it with Grok

```text
Use UnifAPI to pull the current top Hacker News story and summarize it.
```
